items.en: The cat's name is Shiro.

items.en: I put the photograph in a picture frame.

items.en: I will not buy an expensive watch.

items.en: The bus has a fixed fare.

items.en: I will go to the summer festival at night.

items.en: The early-summer wind is still cool.

items.en: I read the job conditions carefully.

items.en: The two countries signed a treaty.

items.en: A town ordinance does not allow fireworks at night.

items.en: The lawyer pointed to the article of the law.

items.ja: 買い物を箇条書きにしました。
items.en: I made a bullet list for the shopping.
